description: 한국지역난방공사_구역전기 태양광 주거용 저압 AMI 전력량 일평균 데이터(역방향) [electricity and power and district heating] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국지역난방공사. 한국지역난방공사의 구역전기 사업 중 태양광 주거용 저압 고객의 일평균 전력량(역방향)을 측정한 데이터로, AMI(지능형 원격검침시스템)를 통해 역송전(전력 판매 또는 잉여 발전량). Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국지역난방공사. Its tags are 역송전, 태양광발전, 전력거래, 잉여전력, 에너지정산. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-08-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
